## Argument

### 0. Dependency gate and evidence layer
TASK.json has empty blocked_dependencies and dependency_artifacts C66-GEO-Z -> ATT-0048 with confirmation reviews REV-0091 and REV-0092. This attempt uses the GEO-Z dependency only through packet-adjudicated findings FND-0062, FND-0063, FND-0073, FND-0097, FND-0099 (all corroborated in C66-001-v4) and the mechanical established facts of the primary working context WORKING-7a483703948f9ea9; the artifact IDs ATT-0048, REV-0091, REV-0092 are cited as the dependency chain wherever the failure-locus input is used. Evidence limitation: the native web-evidence stage was bounded/unavailable and no web findings are used or invented; all inputs are local packet/working-context facts. The primary working context was read end-to-end before drafting; its constraints bind throughout.

### 1. Setup and conventions
Work fibrewise over algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields on smooth balanced tetragonal genus-six curves gamma: C -> P^1, with balanced splitting F = O(4) + O(5) on geometric fibres. Per the working-context constraint, no unframed family-level quantification of W_5 or L is performed; the only family statement (Section 6) is conditionalized on a framing gamma: C -> P^1_B. Use the canonical filtered CE reduction 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 (FND-0097), not a global splitting; on geometric fibres deg(W_f) = 4g+12-4f (SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6) gives deg(W_4)=20, deg(W_5)=16. Set L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}. From the GEO-Z dependency (FND-0063; ATT-0048 confirmed by REV-0091 and REV-0092): for a degree-six divisor Gamma, the f=4 obstruction vanishes identically (degree -4) and CE evaluation fails at Gamma if and only if O_C(Gamma) ~= L. Hence |L| is the fibrewise model of the failure locus, and stratifying the relative degree-six system by h^0 is exactly C66-GEO-H0.

### 2. Degree and Euler characteristic (proved)
deg(L) = deg(W_5) - deg(omega_C) = 16 - 10 = 6 (sha-pinned: 6f4294cbc7166beabebcf00a625753ea71d2e5e71e458ad128f6458235bc972b, ce77273eab522bac4faf80347983e07dcf456b8f0428b4476b838771c238d2b8). Riemann-Roch: chi(L) = deg(L) - g + 1 = 6 - 6 + 1 = 1 (sha-pinned: 04163abaf0c0cb0f9a01c1af0b5f8b4774b23b7d6d011917753e97c6ec10db6e, dc9dcf854e8555eb33fe36e3a270cb5986fe4bd6b200aaf79d572778afd6ad34). Thus h^0(L) = chi(L) + h^1(L) = 1 + h^1(L) >= 1 on every fibre. This is universal symbolic arithmetic, not a finite experiment.

### 3. Serre-duality reparametrization (proved; reproduces FND-0073)
Serre duality gives h^1(L) = h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1}) = h^0(omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^{-1}) =: h^0(M), where M := omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee has degree 2(2g-2) - deg(W_5) = 20 - 16 = 4. Therefore h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M). This re-proves the corroborated finding FND-0073 and, exactly as FND-0073 requires, uses no part of the identification W_5 ~= omega_C^2(-D).

### 4. The stratification (proved from Section 3)
For every r >= 1, {s : h^0(L_s) >= r} = {s : h^0(M_s) >= r-1}. Bound: if h^0(M) > 0, write M ~= O_C(E) with E effective of degree 4; Riemann-Roch gives h^0(M) = h^0(omega_C(-E)) - 1. Since omega_C is base-point-free on a smooth curve, evaluation at any p in supp(E) is surjective on H^0(omega_C), so h^0(omega_C(-p)) = h^0(omega_C) - 1 = 5; as omega_C(-E) is a subsheaf of omega_C(-p), h^0(omega_C(-E)) <= 5, hence h^0(M) <= 4. Thus h^0(L) is in {1,2,3,4,5} and dim |L| = h^0(L)-1 is in {0,1,2,3,4}. The stratum where |L| is at least a net is {h^0(L) >= 3} = {h^0(M) >= 2}, a g^1_4-type Brill-Noether condition on the degree-4 bundle M; the jump strata to P^3 and P^4 are {h^0(M) >= 3} and {h^0(M) >= 4}. This is exactly the packet directive 'Stratify by h^0(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1})' reduced to degree-4 Brill-Noether data, per FND-0073.

### 5. Balanced specialization (source-backed, with explicit caveat)
The primary working context records as an established mechanical fact (relative duality: O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C = omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2), squared and tensored by gamma^*O(-5) with gamma^*O(1) = O_C(D)) that on a balanced tetragonal fibre with fibre divisor D, W_5 ~= omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D); hence L ~= omega_C(-D) and M ~= O_C(D) = gamma^*O_{P^1}(1). Pullback of sections along the surjective morphism gamma injects H^0(P^1, O(1)) (dimension 2) into H^0(C, O_C(D)), so h^0(M) >= 2 and therefore h^0(L) >= 3 everywhere on the balanced locus. The balanced strata are thus: h^0(L)=3 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=2 (the tetragonal pencil is exactly a g^1_4; |L| is a net with fibre P^2); h^0(L)=4 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=3; h^0(L)=5 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=4. Caveat: FND-0073 refers to W_5 ~= omega^2(-D) as the separate GAP-Z-W5D input; clause (iv) is therefore labelled source-backed (working-context established fact) rather than independently proved here, and clauses (i)-(iii) and (v) do not depend on it.

### 6. Relative statement on constant strata (proved under framing; discharges FND-0047)
Fix a framed family gamma: C -> P^1_B over a reduced noetherian base B (a chosen O(1) on the target P^1-bundle), so that W_5 and L are globally defined line bundles; this conditionalization respects the constraint forbidding unframed family-level quantification of W_5/L. Let S_r subset B be a locally closed stratum, with reduced structure, on which h^0(L_s) = r is constant. Since chi(L_s) = 1 for all s, h^1(L_s) = r - 1 is also constant on S_r. By Grauert's cohomology-and-base-change theorem, pi_*L|_{S_r} is locally free of rank r and its formation commutes with base change; the relative complete linear system over S_r is the projective bundle of lines in pi_*L|_{S_r}, of relative dimension r-1, whose fibre over s is |L_s| = P(H^0(C_s, L_s)). Across jump walls no Proj(pi_*L) identification is asserted; the correct global object there is the compatible divisor/Hilbert or Abel-Jacobi incidence construction, as required by FND-0047. The numerical stratification function s -> h^0(L_s) itself is defined fibrewise and is independent of framing.

### 7. Explicit non-claims and gaps
- GAP-H0-1 (constancy/genericity): it is NOT proved that h^0(M)=2 constantly or generically on the balanced locus; the density/nonemptiness of the P^2 stratum and the codimensions of the jump strata h^0(L)>=4 are open (FND-0058 obligation; handed to C66-GEO-COMP). No dimension, purity, or generic-finiteness claim is made, avoiding the constrained '15+2=17 parameter count' route.
- GAP-H0-2 (reduced support): nonemptiness of the reduced-support open, or of the ordered Conf_6 incidence, inside any stratum is NOT established from chi(L)=1 (FND-0083); on special fibres every member of |L| may be non-reduced.
- GAP-H0-3 (scheme structure): no scheme-theoretic comparison of Fitting/determinantal and Abel-Jacobi incidence ideals along jump strata is made (FND-0046); the stratification is fibrewise/set-theoretic.
- GAP-H0-4 (components/stabilizers): components, stabilizers, closure relations, and finite-etale S_6-cover behavior of the strata are deferred to C66-GEO-COMP per the subproblem DAG.

### 8. Failed routes addressed
- FND-0058 route (assert h^0 = 3 constantly to get a relative P^2-bundle of codimension 4): not walked; the P^2 stratum is characterized as the exact-pencil locus and constancy is recorded as a gap.
- FND-0047 route (identify the relative linear system with Proj(pi_*L) while h^0 jumps): not walked; the projective-bundle description is restricted to constant-h^0 strata where cohomology-and-base-change hypotheses are verified.
- FND-0083 route (deduce reduced-support/Conf_6 nonemptiness from chi(L)=1): not walked; explicitly disclaimed in GAP-H0-2.
- Constraint 'parameter count 15+2=17 proves generic finiteness onto a pure codimension-4 component': avoided; no such claim appears.
- Constraint 'quantifying the obstruction splitting, W_5, or L over the whole family rather than over geometric fibres': avoided by fibrewise statements plus the framing conditionalization in Section 6.
- Blocked routes vcd-only-vanishing, undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex, point-count-without-degree-parity-separation, forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown: none is used, and no new_inputs are declared for them.

### 9. Separation of inputs
Proved steps: Sections 2, 3, 4, and 6 (Section 6 conditionalized on framing). Source-backed inputs: Section 5 (working-context mechanical established fact), FND-0063/FND-0073/FND-0097/FND-0099 (corroborated packet findings), SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, and the GEO-Z dependency chain ATT-0048 with REV-0091/REV-0092. Computational hypotheses: none; the sha-pinned arithmetic entries are universal symbolic substitutions used only as pinned checks. Gaps: Section 7. No finite experiment is used to close any universal claim.

theorem_statement: Theorem (h0-stratification of the residual degree-six system, C66-GEO-H0). Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic zero and let gamma: C -> P^1_k be a smooth balanced tetragonal genus-six curve. Let 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 be the canonical filtered Casnati-Ekedahl reduction (FND-0097), with deg(W_5)=16 on the geometric fibre, and set L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}. Then: (i) deg(L)=6 and chi(L)=1, hence h^0(C,L)>=1. (ii) With M := omega_C^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee, one has deg(M)=4 and h^0(C,L) = 1 + h^0(C,M). (iii) Consequently, in any family of such geometric fibres, the h^0(L)-stratification is the Brill-Noether stratification of the degree-4 bundle M shifted by one: {s : h^0(L_s)>=r} = {s : h^0(M_s)>=r-1} for all r>=1; moreover h^0(M)<=4, so h^0(L) is in {1,2,3,4,5} and dim |L_s| = h^0(L_s)-1; the P^2 stratum {h^0(L)>=3} is exactly the relative g^1_4 locus {h^0(M)>=2} of M. (iv) On the balanced locus with fibre divisor D, using the working-context established fibrewise identity W_5 ~= omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), one has M ~= O_C(D) = gamma^*O_{P^1}(1) and L ~= omega_C(-D); since gamma^* injects H^0(P^1,O(1)) into H^0(C,O_C(D)), h^0(M)>=2 and h^0(L)>=3 everywhere on the balanced locus, and the strata are exactly h^0(L)=3 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=2 (exact-pencil locus, |L| a net), h^0(L)=4 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=3, h^0(L)=5 <=> h^0(O_C(D))=4. (v) Over any framed family gamma: C -> P^1_B (so that O(1), hence W_5 and L, are globally defined) and any reduced locally closed stratum S_r on which h^0(L_s)=r is constant, pi_*L|_{S_r} is locally free of rank r with formation commuting with base change (Grauert), and the relative complete linear system over S_r is the projective bundle of lines in pi_*L|_{S_r} of relative dimension r-1; no Proj(pi_*L) identification is asserted across jump walls (FND-0047). Not claimed: constancy of h^0(M)=2 on the balanced locus, dimensions/codimensions/components/stabilizers of jump strata, and nonemptiness of reduced-support opens.
